name: Hallway: matches are slow
expression: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate({otel_metric_name="dash0.spans.duration", service_name="hallway-api", deployment_environment_name="hackathon", dash0_operation_name="GET /api/matches"}[5m]))) * 1000 > $__threshold

annotations.summary: p95 of GET /api/matches is {{ $value | printf "%.0f" }} ms
annotations.description: Our target is 95% of matches under 800 ms. Open a slow trace and look at the match.query span: chaos mode `slow` sleeps there, and a slow Elasticsearch shows up as the search span under it.
